other_returns_notes: All figures above (except as noted) are for the Core Fund (~93% of WRS assets), Time-Weighted, 1-Year, as of 12/31/2017, gross of management fees except Private Equity/Debt which is net of fees. 'Public Equities' (mapped to global_equity per instructions since Core Fund equities are unified into one Global Equities sleeve starting ~2017) actual 24.0% vs 'Aggregated Equities Benchmark' 24.0%. 'Inflation Sensitive' (mapped to real_assets_commodities) actual 3.2% vs 'Aggregated Inflation Sensitive Benchmark' 3.1%. 'Real Estate' actual 9.6% vs '100% ODCE Benchmark (since 1/1/13)' 7.7%. 'Private Equity/Debt' actual 16.8% vs 'Aggregated Private Equity Benchmark' 14.3%. 'Multi Asset' (mapped to hedge_fund_absolute_return, since SWIB discloses this category 'consists primarily of hedge funds') actual 14.5% vs 'Aggregated Multi Asset Benchmark' 16.4% -- note this table's Multi Asset benchmark differs from the narrower '3-Month LIBOR+10bps' hedge-fund/Alpha-Pool policy benchmark documented in this plan's Part-A composition research for FY2017; both are genuine SWIB-disclosed figures for different scopes. Separately, the Variable Fund (the remainder of WRS assets): total return 23.2% vs benchmark 23.1%; Variable Fund Public Equities 23.3% vs Aggregated Equities Benchmark 23.1%. Also separately, the GASB-67 'Schedule of Investment Returns' (Financial Section RSI, money-weighted IRR net of fees, a different methodology) reports Core Trust Fund 15.85% and Variable Trust Fund 23.27% for CY2017 -- no benchmark given there.
